required_extensions.requirement: The implemented temporal gate requires all registered 34 points in every thread/RAM stratum, explicit temporal dimensions, unique captured run IDs, retained input hashes/context/image and three successful raw observations per point. It reports the combined default 27-coordinate temporal grid separately and bounds the seven branch centers to point-only support.

The implemented guard compares actual validated series/timepoint shape, regularity, time unit, sampling design and steady-state sample count before profile selection. Unknown or mismatched temporal shapes fall back with a warning/provenance instead of pooling equal-column profiles. It does not establish temporal size-growth estimation or prediction accuracy.

The prediction helper freezes the actual ANDREA planner code, cost snapshot and eight exact-profile calls (genes75/250 across four resource strata) before collecting 24 observations. Validation uses the actual planning ETA; nearest-p50 times the same core size scale is retained as a typical-duration diagnostic. Any operational reserve is separate and cannot help pass the planning coverage threshold. Temporal-shape growth remains unsupported.

measurement_status: The first image passed 12 physical tests, then stopped at a catalog-renderer error before any calibration. Recovery rebuilds corrected version 1.0.1 and applies the expanded 17-case physical acceptance before calibration; no cost or held-out accuracy is claimed by this plan.
limitations: Measurement, finite-domain coverage, actual-core-planner independent accuracy and the final acceptance dossier are separate gates. Calibration stays private until domain and 24-observation prediction checks pass. Predictions across temporal shapes remain unsupported; no image or package publication is performed.

continuation_budget.note: Serial execution cap, 18.75 days; not an ETA. No automatic retries; build/startup/validation overhead remains unknown.

diagnostic_probes.scope: Read-only saved-model checks inside their fit container, included in the 3600-second case limit; no extra fit/container.
